title: OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data
displayTitle: OpenAI 开始试点 Private Inference，争取企业敏感工作负载
summary: The Decoder 转述 OpenAI 表示，Private Inference 已向首批企业客户试点，通过隔离硬件处理请求，并称可独立验证安全性。
investorNote: 企业采购需分别核对隔离边界、审计机制、滥用审查及数据处理条款。
narrative: The Decoder 转述 OpenAI 称，Private Inference 已向首批企业客户试点，使用隔离硬件处理敏感请求。安全性是供应商的设计与承诺，企业仍需独立核对隔离边界、审计及滥用审查流程。

evidence.quote: OpenAI is testing a new feature called "Private Inference" that lets companies run queries on its most powerful models without OpenAI being able to access the data.
